QuestInfo.name: Kyrin's Orders
QuestInfo.0: Ready to set sail across Maple World? Before you go forth, talk to #b#p1090000##k, captain of the Nautilus.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1090000##k ordered you to help #p1091003#, who's in charge of Nautilus's food supply. She'd have given you a tougher job, but she didn't want you to get hurt. #b#p1091003##k is in the #r#m120020000##k.

0.0: Ahoy there! Are you ready for high adventure on the seven seas as a crew member of the Nautilus?

yes.0: That's the spirit! What mission shall I send you on first? I'd love to send you on a real swashbuckling adventure, but you just aren't ready for it, are you?
yes.1: That's okay, I've got just the job for you. Go see #b#p1091003##k, who's in charge of the ship's food, and see if she needs any help. She's probably in the #r#m120020000##k.

no.0: And you call yourself a Pirate? Shameful!

1.0: And who might you be? Oh, you're the newest Pirate, ain't ya? #p1090000# finally send someone to help me out? About time!\r\nLeave it to the cap'n to saddle me with a rookie like you. Still, I think I can put you to work.

yes.0: Don't worry, I won't work you hard. Not too hard, anyway. And here, since you'll be helping me out, I want you to have this. I bet it'll look great on you.

npc.0: Report to #b#p1091003##k in the #r#m120020000##k. And welcome to the Nautilus!
